records.subject: INLAND WATER TRANSPORT ON THE MAHANADI
records.extent:
IWAI has also proposed to construct jetties for river Cruise Tourism and local communities 
at 07 locations along Mahanadi River, i.e, Dhubaleswar, Naraj, Baliput, Badmul, 
Kamaladiha,  Kantilo (Bhitarkanika  Temple & Nilamadhava Temple), thereby promoting river
based tourism, enhancing passenger connectivity, creating livelihood opportunities for local 
communities and contributing to the overall socio-economic development of the region.

records.subject: EKLAVYA MODEL RESIDENTIAL SCHOOLS IN ODISHA
records.extent:
(a) to (c): Ministry of Tribal Affairs has sanctioned 114 Eklavya Model Residential Schools 
(EMRSs) in the State of Odisha. As on date, 47 EMRSs are functional. Construction of 62 EMRS 
buildings has been completed, while 45 EMRSs are at different stages of construction and 7 are at 
preconstruction stage.

records.subject: Status of Paradeep-Duburi NH-53 National Highway Project
records.extent:
The 4-laning of Duburi-Chandikhole section of NH-53 (Package-II) for a length of 39.400 Km. is in
(a)
progress with physical progress of 82%. Out of 39.400 Km., the 4-laning of 34.100 Km. length has been
◦completed. The revised scheduled date of completion of the project is February, 2025.
